loc-bacon-commissioner-of-insurance-rep-.background: Republican incumbent Georgia Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, appointed in 2019 and elected to a full term in 2022. A former Atlanta police officer and Doraville police chief, he served four decades in the Army National Guard, retiring as a major general in 2023.

positions.stance: At the Atlanta Press Club debate (reported Oct. 14, 2026) said private insurance has filled the gap left by lost ACA subsidies, citing close to a million Georgians with private health insurance.
Said his office has recovered more than $100 million for insurance consumers since 2019 (his own figure; Oct. 2026 debate).
Warned against letting artificial intelligence determine insurance policies and cautioned that consumers could be scammed by fake insurance products (Oct. 2026 debate).
Said his office is investigating the death of a rider on Six Flags Over Georgia's Goliath ride and will 'go with this where the facts take us' (Oct. 2026 debate).
